setlist.title: It's All Over Now Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out the Dupree's as a nice moment of the show; First Dupree's since 3-26-90, excluding Phil & Friends on 9/24/94, and the last one the Dead ever played [8][11]
- **Playin' in the Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer praises great jamming in the Playin' into Uncle John's Band segment; Reviewer loves Playin', finding the opening riff quintessential Dead and later-era versions especially fitting [10][16]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Vince's synth wash and Bobby's MIDI sounds ruin an Other One that might have been good; The Other One intro leaves reviewer wishing the band had stopped after Brent died [12][19]
- **It's All Over Now Baby Blue** (2 reviews): Jerry is in great vocal form on the Baby Blue; Reviewer calls the Baby Blue encore wonderful [8][10]
- **Loser** (1 review): Garcia is in rare form in set one, with Loser among the best of his songs [9]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Vince plays very well on Wharf Rat, in contrast to the Other One [12]
- **Johnny B Goode** (1 review): Show builds steadily from The Other One and Wharf Rat to a climax; reviewer calls the Johnny B. Goode the year's best [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Dupree's Diamond Blues**: back after 151 archived shows (650 days) [20]
- **Percussion Space**: back after 129 archived shows (563 days); rare: 4 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-10-13.schoeps.andrewf.88357.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 175 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Fuzzy, overloaded low end appears in a few spots, including Masterpiece, Loose Lucy, Baby Blue and Drums/Space [1]
- **gd1994-10-13.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-33299.33822.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 4/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Vocals and instruments are clear throughout, and the jamming lives up to the band's legend [17]
- **gd94-10-13.sbd.wiley.7800.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 169 min; rated 3.54/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording sounds really good all the way through [13]
- **gd1994-10-13.sbd-patched.miller.33299.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 169 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard dropouts in Touch of Grey and Wang Dang Doodle were patched with audience recording [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer finds Jerry playing very sweetly and the band present, though the show is not earth-shaking [12]
- Reviewer attended the show in person and had not heard it again until downloading it years later [13]
- Bill Tetzeli made the transition between CD2 and CD3 seamless [2]
- Reviewer finds this show better start to finish than 10/14, which is overshadowed by that night's Scarlet>Fire [8]
- The Playin'>Uncle John's Band is solid but well below the 10/5/94 pairing, which has tasty jamming after UJB [9]
- Reviewer calls this the best first set of the run and thinks 10/14/94 is overrated [10]
- At the time, 10/14 and 10/17 stood out most from the Fall '94 Garden run [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-10-13.schoeps.andrewf.88357.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (ORTF) > Oade mic power supply > Casio DA-7 (lead deck) > Coax SPDIF > Casio DA-7 (first deck out) > TDK DC4. Mics on 7-foot stand, directly… [1]. Also: Schoeps-mic recording; the break between discs 2 and 3 is seamless, with fades made in Soundforge [1]
- **gd1994-10-13.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-33299.33822.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD -> EAC -> FLAC [2]. Also: All sources came from Tim Wiley; soundboard has no noise reduction, and the audience source was remastered with Samplitude [2]
- **gd94-10-13.sbd.wiley.7800.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> C> DAT> CDR> EAC> Cool Edit> SHN [3]. Also: Soundboard went through DAT, cassette, DAT, CDR, EAC and Cool Edit to SHN, via Paul Bottiglio and Tim Wiley [3]
- **gd1994-10-13.sbd-patched.miller.33299.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Patched By Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD -> EAC -> FLAC [4]. Also: Sources from Tim Wiley; soundboard has no noise reduction, and the patching was done in Samplitude [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden](https://wallpaperhdcornelia.blogspot.com/2021/05/grateful-dead-madison-square-garden.html) [21]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1994-10-13 Thu Madison Square Garden, New York, NY](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1415916966456/grateful-dead-1994-10-13-thu-madison) [22]
